text: Supplier shall maintain a 98% OTIF score. If OTIF falls below target for two consecutive quarters, a 3% penalty applies to non-compliant purchase orders.
Walmart may assess a chargeback deduction of 1.5% of gross invoice value on non-compliant shipments.
On-time delivery below 95% for any calendar month entitles Buyer to liquidated damages of 2% of the monthly order value.
Fill-rate shortfalls are subject to an administrative fee equal to 4% of the cost of goods not delivered in-full.
Buyer may offset against future invoices any amounts owed for shipments that miss the agreed delivery window.
If the delivery score drops below 97.5%, Buyer may withhold payment of 2.5% until performance is restored.
Remedies for late or incomplete shipment include a credit of 1% of the affected purchase order.
Vendor accepts a compliance charge of 3% for each purchase order delivered late or short.
Late deliveries will reduce the amount payable by 2% of the invoice.
In-full delivery below 96% triggers a deduction from the next settlement equal to 2.75% of affected orders.
Force majeure events, including supply chain disruptions, shall suspend performance obligations without penalty.
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware without regard to conflict of law principles.
Neither party shall disclose proprietary information to third parties without prior written consent.
Each shipment shall include a packing list and a bill of lading.
Supplier shall pay all fees associated with obtaining required food safety certifications.
Shipment labels must follow the Buyer's routing guide; questions go to the vendor support desk.
Either party may terminate for convenience with ninety days' written notice; no damages shall be owed for such termination.
Vendor will receive a quarterly on-time performance report through the supplier portal for information only; no fee or penalty applies to this report.
Insurance certificates naming Buyer as additional insured are due within 30 days of signature.
The parties are independent contractors and nothing herein creates a partnership or joint venture.
